title: The Best Pet Grooming, in Boston

facts.fact: Onyva, a Newbury newcomer listed in Boston magazine's Best Pet Grooming archive, offers a membership plan that includes one de-matting treatment to start, then two deep cleanings and unlimited brush-and-go quick visits.
facts.value: one de-matting treatment to start; two deep cleanings; unlimited brush-and-go quick visits
facts.quote: This Newbury newcomer offers an innovative membership plan that includes one de-matting treatment to start and then two deep cleanings and unlimited brush-and-go quick visits

facts.fact: Boston magazine's page labels the Onyva entry as a 2021 Best Pet Grooming award, although the entry's URL path is under /2023/.
